Visiting

Pantai Carocok tickets & fees

Pesisir Selatan Regulation No. 9 of 2023 lists Pantai Carocok Painan admission at Rp10,000 per adult and Rp5,000 per child, per person per entry. Use this as a budget reference and check the displayed rate at the official ticket counter on arrival.

Updated · 27 November 2026

Official reference and its date

Annex XI of Regulation No. 9 of 2023 distinguishes adult and child admission. The government report of 30 March 2026 also records ticket receipts consistent with those rates. These are dated sources, rather than a guarantee for every future visit.

Keep four budget items separate

Do not assume admission covers the whole trip. Ask what is included before paying and keep payment receipts.

  • Site admission: check adult and child numbers against the official counter notice.
  • Parking: ask for the vehicle rate and any time limit.
  • Cingkuak boat: agree one-way or return travel, pickup point and which passengers are charged.
  • Water activities: ask separately about equipment hire, duration and safety equipment.

Payment and a change of plan

The government reported digital ticketing in March 2026. Carry small cash and ask which payment methods are working; avoid relying on a single e-wallet. If sea conditions prevent a crossing, allow for a land-based visit and a meal in Painan.

Questions

Before you go

01How much is admission to Pantai Carocok?+

Regulation No. 9 of 2023 lists Rp10,000 per adult and Rp5,000 per child per entry. This is a dated official reference; check the counter rate on arrival.

02Does admission include a Cingkuak boat?+

Do not assume it does. Ask about boats, parking and activities separately before paying.

03Are children or seniors free?+

The regulation lists a child ticket category, rather than automatic free entry. Ask staff about age limits and exemptions.

04Can I pay digitally?+

The government reported digital ticketing on 30 March 2026. Check which methods work at the counter on your visit and carry backup cash.
